_doc: Per-character tuning for process-sprites.mjs. frames.<pose>: { dx, dy } shifts the computed anchor in sheet pixels (positive dx moves the anchor right, positive dy moves it down). holeFill: also clear enclosed pure-white gaps (not for white clothing). blobMergeGap: dilation in px used to keep detached effects with their frame. frames.<pose>.scale multiplies the sheet scale of that one frame (a model that drew a frame smaller than the others). holeFillC/holeFillD: holeFill for the animation sheets only. scaleRefC/scaleRefD: frame whose content height is normalised to bodyHeight (default idle_0 and punch_2). frames.<pose>.copyOf: reuse another frame instead of the sheet's own (for a frame the model drew off-model).
